# Coding Standards Rule

## Universal Standards

- Preserve existing architecture and repository conventions.
- Prefer small, reviewable changes over broad rewrites.
- Keep public interfaces explicit and stable unless approved.
- Keep functions/components cohesive and testable.
- Add concise comments only where logic is non-obvious.

## Quality Expectations

- Handle errors explicitly.
- Avoid hidden side effects.
- Keep naming clear and domain-oriented.
- Update tests when behavior changes.
- Update documentation for externally visible changes.
